title: SQL Injection - Login Bypass

remediation: Use parameterized queries, prepared statements, and secure authentication validation

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
impact: Execution of attacker-controlled JavaScript in a victim's browser through crafted input
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding, sanitize untrusted input, and implement Content Security Policy

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
impact: Persistent execution of malicious scripts when users view stored content; potential session theft and unauthorized actions
remediation: Apply server-side input validation, HTML sanitization, context-aware output encoding, and Content Security Policy
